messages:
DevOps Bot: ALERT: DriftWatcher detected AZ capacity mismatch in staging-us-west1. Desired nodepool (gpu-staging-b) defined in git has 3 GPUs in us-west1-b but live cluster shows 0 nodes in -b and quota exhausted. OPA policy 'zone-affinity' denying terraform apply.

Alex M: ugh. where did the nodes go? was there a rolling-maintenance or autoscaler eviction?

Maria P: saw a partial upgrade this morning, but kube-autoscaler shouldn't remove all GPUs. attaching terraform plan snippet:
```
# terraform plan: module.nodepool.gpu_count: +3 -> 3 desired
resource "google_compute_instance_group" "gpu-staging-b" {
  desired_size = 3
}
```
live check:
```
gcloud compute instances list --filter="zone:(us-west1-b) tags:gpu" | wc -l
0
```

Samir: OPA blocked the gitops apply because we have a policy preventing cross-az allocation change without an approved RCA. DriftWatcher created a dry-run PR but argo sync failed.

Ingrid: can we soft-fail the policy for a canary? We could create 1 node in -b to test and keep audit log. Otherwise apps in staging that rely on -b locality will keep failing.

Maria P: @deploy-bot attempted to reconcile and got this response from OPA:
```
DENY: zone-affinity policy: attempted to create nodepool gpu-staging-b in us-west1-b but project-quota-gpu < requested.
```
So quota is the blocker, not git config.

Alex M: quota shortfall means we either request quota bump (slow) or move some workloads off GPUs in -b. Any cheap apps we can shift to -a or -c?

Samir: propose temporary actions:
- drain noncritical gpu pods with label team=infra-temp
- scale nodepool gpu-staging-a -> +1 (cheap, already has quota)
- open a quota request for us-west1-b (TICKET-4821)

Ingrid: +1. I'll make the pod drain patch and coordinate with QA. Someone needs to approve the OPA override if we go that route.

DevOps Bot: NOTE: DriftWatcher created issue #DRIFT-202 for tracking and posted a reconcile dry-run: https://git.internal/r/diff/DRIFT-202

Maria P: quick cost note: moving workloads temporarily to gpu-staging-a will increase cross-AZ egress for some tests; estimate +$60/day for the staging account while we wait on quota.

Alex M: ok let's do Samir's steps. Ingrid, can you own the pod drains? Samir, open the OPA override RFC if needed. I'll follow up with infra-approvals on the quota ticket.

Ingrid: taking drains now. Will post when pods evicted.

deploy-bot: tried reconcile: `argo sync gpu-staging` -> failed -> OPA deny

Samir: creating OPA override PR with canary=1 and audit-only flag. PR: https://git.internal/p/prs/1234

Alex M: thanks team. keep updates here. If quota bump comes in earlier we rollback the temporary scale.

DevOps Bot: closing alert (sent to #incidents) but tracking remains in #DRIFT-202. :white_check_mark:
